patch_list: Force enable Megaphone, Tamper Detection, Krutrim and Kruti

Forces the Megaphone, Tamper & Fall Detection, Krutrim Assistant, and Kruti features to always report as available, regardless of the server-driven onboarding feature flags returned by the app's backend.
